character.description: Omo, an original chibi kitten who walks upright: soft charcoal-gray fur with no stripes, white muzzle, white chest and white paw tips, big round amber eyes, tiny pink nose, pointed ears with pink inner ear, long tail with a white tip, mint-green knitted scarf with a small white ring stitched on its end, small orange sneakers

chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

fall.action: parachuting descent, front-facing. Its body is LARGE, filling roughly two thirds of the cell height, same body scale as a standing pose. A compact round tan parachute hugs close above its head on short lines - the canopy is small, about half its body height. First frame arms up mid-air, second frame the compact canopy pops open, remaining frames gently descending holding the straps, calm face; the final frame is a steady hold with the canopy open

style: match the attached base reference image EXACTLY: same clean flat cartoon style, same body proportions (big round head), same dark-brown outline weight, same palette, same soft cel shading, same level of detail.
